mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate for equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decrease in the unemployment rate and increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals a strengthening labor market and rising consumer confidence, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE falls by at least 0.2% and RSAFS rises by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.0% annually), a concurrent increase in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates excessive demand that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.0% and both RSAFS and HOUST rise by at least 0.5% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior month indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO rises by at least 0.3% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 5.5% for two consecutive months, it signals an impending economic slowdown that reduces corporate profit expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a tightening monetary policy amid rising inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises by at least 0.2% and CPIAUCSL rises by at least 0.3% over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of periods where INDPRO falls below 100.0 for two consecutive months.
